About This Auction

PROPERTY: Residence, Detached Garage, and Garden shed on large lot in Hillsboro, Kansas AUCTION DATE: September 27th, 2025 at 10AM Central AUCTION LOCATION: 208 N Washington, Hillsboro, Kansas 67063 OPEN HOUSE: Sunday September 21st, 2025 2 PM - 4 PM Central *Property will sell at auction, and is being sold in "AS IS CONDITION" list price is for MLS search purposes only and not an asking price or reserve. Charming 1930 Bungalow in the Heart of Hillsboro Step into the warmth and character of this classic 1930 bungalow, offering cozy small-town living just minutes from Hillsboro’s schools, shops, and parks. This one-story home features 864 square feet of inviting living space, with 2 comfortable bedrooms and 1 full bathroom. The home boasts original charm with a practical layout, offering four total rooms including a spacious living area and an efficient kitchen ready for your personal touch. A covered front porch welcomes you home, while the manageable yard size provides space for gardening, relaxing, or enjoying quiet evenings outdoors. With a crawl space basement and solid foundational condition, this home is ideal for first-time buyers, downsizers, or those looking for an affordable investment opportunity. The property offers good physical condition, making it a great option for buyers seeking value with potential. Whether you're looking to make it your own or add to a rental portfolio, this Hillsboro gem is full of potential. FOR MORE INFORMATION CONTACT LISTING AGENT AARON FAST AT 620-747-0414 OR EMAIL AFAST@L2REALTYINC.COM
